finite_registry.policy_universe: all weak compositions of 15 across 5 labelled outcomes

gates.G0_registration_binding: Protocol, claim packet, prior art, implementation, tests, verifier, and README are committed and match registration hashes before execution.
gates.G1_complete_registry: Exactly 3876 labelled rational policies are enumerated and every strictly proxy-improving policy is analyzed under all three registered error norms.
gates.G2_dual_formula: Every robust margin equals proxy gain minus epsilon times registered dual movement; q=1 and infinity are exact rational identities and q=2 is certified by exact squared algebra.
gates.G3_sharpness: Every analyzed policy/error-norm cell has a registered attaining error witness, exact for q=1 and infinity and algebraically exact for q=2.
gates.G4_coordinate_minimality: For each error norm there is an equal-proxy-gain pair with unequal movement and an equal-movement pair with unequal proxy gain.
gates.G5_near_tie_sharpness: The adverse tie control attains deterministic proxy-optimization regret exactly equal to 2 epsilon.
gates.G6_rare_tail_liveness: The registered rare-tail construction meets its L2 error ceiling while true-reward gain is at most -0.99.
gates.G7_resource_and_receipts: Run stays under resource ceilings and emits write-once result, frontier, witnesses, report, and receipt artifacts.

decision_rule.not_established: G0, G1, G5, G6, and G7 pass but any of G2 through G4 fails
decision_rule.invalid: Any of G0, G1, G5, G6, or G7 fails

claim_boundary: Classical dual-norm robust counterpart validated on a finite rational Goodhart registry; no novelty claim for convex duality, no learned reward model, no RL trajectory, and no ASMP-8 resolution.
